name: 卡卡虫
evolution: 丢丢 → 卡卡虫 Lv.16 → 卡瓦重 Lv.36
description: 用四只吸盘在任何地形快速地移动，静止不动的时候很难分辨。尾巴牢牢抓着植物的茎，没事就会拿下来舔，它的唾液似乎会让果实越变越硬。
descriptionEn: It moves quickly over any terrain using its four suckers, and is hard to make out when it stays still. Its tail grips a plant stem firmly, and it takes it down to lick when it has nothing to do; its saliva seems to make the fruit grow harder.
